entries: {SOMEONE:!threatening} gave {first} a statement at {landmark} {MANNER}, and it held.
{first} {ACT_PERSON} {SOMEONE:human}, but the {rival} had already taken a statement from {CLOSE:human}.
Every lead {first} followed toward {PRIZE:!inner} ended in {VICE}.
{the_thing} had passed through the hands of {SOMEONE:human,!plural}, and {first} {ACT_PERSON} {the_someone:human}.
{first} traced {THING:portable} to {landmark} and waited for the owner {MANNER}.
{the_someone:human} gave three versions of {TOPIC}, and {first} wrote down all of them.
